source.vendoring_note: apply_patch adds one terminal newline; content bytes otherwise match the captured JSON.

read_only_policy: Only GET reference retrieval operations are listed. POST/PATCH/DELETE are omitted. RPC GET entries are retained as documented reference endpoints and are schema-only unless observed.

license.curated_content: CC0 1.0 Universal (as stated by the CPIC repository license)
license.attribution: CPIC requests attribution, source URL, access date, and version; API terms point to the ClinPGx data usage policy. No ClinPGx license is inferred.
